# Depth UI

> Depth UI is a free, open-source library of copy-paste 3D React components built with CSS 3D transforms, Tailwind CSS v4 and Framer Motion. No WebGL. Light and dark themes. MIT licensed.

- Live demo: https://depthui.vercel.app
- All components: https://depthui.vercel.app/components
- Source: https://github.com/depthui/depthui

Every component page has a live preview, usage code, the full source and a props table. Components include tilt cards, 3D carousels, a wireframe globe, a kanban board with drag and drop, form controls, a command palette, drawers and more.
